title: Account home, balances and transaction feed freshness
workflow: Resolve authorized customer and selected account scopes
Fetch source-linked ledger balances and account restrictions
Separate posted movements, pending card/payment/deposit items and reservations
Show last-updated timestamp and explicit stale/unavailable errors
Offer filtered accessible history without merging currencies
Escalate source/reconciliation inconsistencies rather than displaying fabricated zero
invariants: Projection data is never a secondary system-of-record ledger
No account belonging to another institution appears in results
A pending incoming transfer cannot inflate posted balance without evidence
Account currency and decimal formatting are consistent and localized
Read caching declares freshness and obeys privacy/expiry policy
A reversed journal displays correction rather than vanishing
High-contrast, accessible text must remain readable at mobile sizes
acceptance_tests: Cross-account filter does not leak private transactions
Pending credit not counted as posted
Unavailable source avoids false zero balance
independent_gate: Approved account/ledger read API, privacy review and actual usability/integration testing.
